market_id.description: Unique contract ID, preserved as text.
market_id.source: active_candidates + reviewed register + effective market metadata

condition_id.source: active_candidates + reviewed register + effective market metadata

topic.description: Audited topic: Sports, Politics or Economics.
topic.source: active_candidates + reviewed register + effective market metadata

question.source: active_candidates + reviewed register + effective market metadata

slug.source: active_candidates + reviewed register + effective market metadata

event_id.description: Parent API event ID; different from the real-world family.
event_id.source: active_candidates + reviewed register + effective market metadata

event_family_id.description: Audited grouping of contracts about the same real-world event.
event_family_id.source: active_candidates + reviewed register + effective market metadata

outcome_0_token_id.description: Token whose probability and result define this forecast.
outcome_0_token_id.source: active_candidates + reviewed register + effective market metadata

outcome_1_token_id.description: Other token in the same binary contract.
outcome_1_token_id.source: active_candidates + reviewed register + effective market metadata

outcome_0_name.description: Canonical display name for token index 0; not always Yes.
outcome_0_name.source: active_candidates + reviewed register + effective market metadata

outcome_1_name.description: Canonical display name for token index 1.
outcome_1_name.source: active_candidates + reviewed register + effective market metadata

event_month.description: Calendar month of the reviewed event boundary, YYYY-MM.
event_month.source: active_candidates + reviewed register + effective market metadata

event_time_utc.description: Reviewed event boundary, preserving supplied subsecond precision.

reviewed_cutoff_utc.description: Reviewed boundary minus 24 hours before integer-second conversion.

original_event_time_utc.description: Original discovery anchor, retained for provenance.

closed_time_utc.description: Saved closing time, known after the forecast.

forecast_cutoff_utc.description: Effective integer-second collection cutoff: floor(event time)-86400.

window_start_utc.description: Later of listing time rounded up to seconds and cutoff minus seven days.

forecast_observation_utc.description: Timestamp of the selected observed cutoff probability.

window_hours.description: Actual collection exposure in hours; not assumed to be seven days.

forecast_probability.description: Observed probability of outcome 0 at/before cutoff.

cutoff_floor_difference_seconds.description: Reviewed cutoff minus integer-second cutoff, in [0,1).

forecast_age_seconds.description: Effective cutoff minus selected price-observation timestamp.

family_market_count.description: Number of retained contracts sharing this real-world family.

outcome_0_result.description: Audited settled outcome: 0 or 1. An outcome, never a pre-cutoff predictor.

forecast_price_source.description: hourly or one_minute_fallback; finer snapshots are not mixed into the hourly path.

evidence_status.description: Current accepted evidence status; supersedes provisional capture flags.

boundary_type.description: Meaning of the accepted event-time boundary.

time_precision.description: Precision stated by the event-time audit.

event_source_urls.description: External evidence links recorded by the audit, separated as in source.

timing_sensitivity_range_pp.description: Observed range over retained timing scenarios, in percentage points; not a confidence interval.

short_window.description: Collection window is shorter than 168 hours.

original_anchor_differs.description: Original discovery anchor differs from accepted event time.

sampling_month_differs.description: Audited event month differs from the original sampling stratum.

is_replacement.description: Market was selected from the saved replacement reserve.

collection_pilot.description: Market belongs to the nested collection pilot.

sampling_month.description: Original month stratum; not overwritten after event-time corrections.

replaces_market_id.description: Prior market occupying this sampling slot; null for original selections.

event_inclusion_probability.description: Saved original-design probability; not a final inverse-probability weight.

reported_lifetime_volume.description: Reported lifetime metadata volume; unavailable for some markets and not a historical window feature.

event_structure.description: Audited structure of the parent choice group.

option_count_at_cutoff.description: Reconstructed count if justified; null for unknown/nonexclusive groups.

listed_alternative_count_snapshot.description: Descriptive count in the later event response; not backdated to the forecast.

alternatives_mutually_exclusive.description: Whether the choice-group alternatives are mutually exclusive.

contemporaneous_menu_verified.description: Whether a contemporaneous historical menu was directly verified; false throughout this version.

trade_row_count.description: All returned rows, retaining ambiguous repeats.

transaction_count.description: Distinct transaction hashes represented in this market's window.

observed_wallet_count.description: Distinct observed wallet addresses; not necessarily distinct people.

exact_duplicate_excess.description: Repeated exact rows beyond one per signature.

exact_duplicate_group_count.description: Number of exact signatures occurring more than once.

sensitivity_trade_row_count.description: One row per exact signature, for sensitivity analysis only.

price_point_count.description: Observed hourly first-token prices; excludes finer cutoff recovery.

price_interval_count.description: Number of adjacent observed hourly pairs.

price_gaps_over_90_minutes.description: Count of adjacent observed intervals exceeding 5400 seconds.

price_gaps_over_6_hours.description: Count of adjacent observed intervals exceeding 21600 seconds.

gross_account_activity.description: Recorded trading activity ($): sum(price*size) over all returned account rows; not reconciled exchange turnover.

sensitivity_account_activity.description: Same sum after keeping the first row per exact signature.

account_activity_per_observed_day.description: Recorded trading activity ($/day): gross_account_activity divided by actual window hours/24; not an extrapolated weekly total.

wallet_trade_count.description: Number of distinct (market_id, wallet_address, transaction_hash, token_id, side) groups in the collected window; zero with no returned records. Groups approximate wallet trading actions, not verified submitted orders.

mean_wallet_trade_notional.description: Average wallet trade size ($): sum price*size within each (market_id, wallet_address, transaction_hash, token_id, side) group, then take the unweighted mean across groups. Counterparties, outcome tokens and BUY/SELL directions stay separate; ambiguous repeated records are retained. Null with no groups; not verified order size or exchange turnover.

mean_trade_row_size.description: Mean shares per returned account row; null when no rows were returned.

mean_trade_row_notional.description: Mean price*size per returned account row.

top_wallet_activity_share.description: Largest wallet sum(price*size) / gross account activity, in [0,1].

top_five_wallet_activity_share.description: Combined five largest wallet activity shares; all wallets if fewer than five.

wallet_activity_hhi.description: Sum of squared wallet activity shares, in (0,1]; null with no denominator.

sensitivity_top_wallet_share.description: Top-wallet share in the exact-signature sensitivity view.

sensitivity_wallet_hhi.description: Wallet HHI in the exact-signature sensitivity view.

duplicate_activity_difference_pct.description: 100*(all-row activity - sensitivity activity)/all-row activity; null for zero activity.

zero_returned_trades.description: No API trade rows in the bounded pre-cutoff window; does not mean no lifetime trading.

trade_summary_status.description: observed_rows or no_returned_trades; explains missing row means/concentration.

price_path_status.description: observed_hourly_path, single_hourly_observation, or no_hourly_observations; cutoff snapshot availability is separate.

max_price_gap_hours.description: Longest adjacent observed interval; null when fewer than two points exist.

median_price_gap_seconds.description: Median elapsed seconds between observed points.

leading_price_gap_hours.description: Time from window start to first hourly observation; null for an empty series.

trailing_price_gap_hours.description: Time from last hourly observation to cutoff, separately from selected snapshot age.

max_observed_price_step_pp.description: Largest absolute adjacent probability difference in percentage points; may span a gap.

flat_hourly_series.description: All observed probabilities equal, with at least two points; null if no path.

observed_steps_ge_20pp.description: Number of adjacent observed price changes at least 20 percentage points; null if no path.

price_movement_pp_per_hour.description: Sum of absolute probability changes in percentage points divided by elapsed hours, using adjacent hourly-history observations 1800-5400 seconds apart inclusive; null with no eligible intervals.

usable_price_intervals.description: Number of adjacent hourly-history intervals 1800-5400 seconds apart inclusive used for price movement; zero when unavailable.

price_movement_observed_hours.description: Sum of elapsed hours in usable price intervals; excludes gaps outside 1800-5400 seconds and need not form a continuous period; zero when unavailable.

favorite_index.description: Token index favored at the cutoff: 0 if first-token probability exceeds 0.5, 1 if below; null at exactly 0.5. This fixed orientation applies to all earlier purchases and trend observations.

favorite_probability.description: max(forecast_probability, 1-forecast_probability); 0.5 at a tie, when no token is favored. This is confidence, not correctness.

purchase_count.description: Grouped BUY count using (market_id, wallet_address, transaction_hash, token_id, side); both tokens included, ambiguous repeats retained. Zero with no BUY records.

large_purchase_count.description: Grouped BUY purchases worth at least five times the market's median grouped BUY value; zero when none qualify. Nonpositive medians do not define a relative-size threshold.

median_purchase_value.description: Median grouped BUY value ($) across both outcome tokens in the collected pre-cutoff window; null with no BUY purchases.

large_threshold.description: Five times median_purchase_value ($); exploratory relative-size cutoff, not an absolute whale threshold. Null with no purchases.

large_favorite_purchase_value.description: Sum of qualifying grouped BUY dollars backing the cutoff favorite; zero if a favorite exists but no qualifying purchases back it; null when no favorite exists.

large_purchase_favorite_share.description: Qualifying grouped BUY dollars backing the cutoff favorite divided by all qualifying BUY dollars, in [0,1]. Null without qualifying purchases, a positive median or a cutoff favorite; zero means observed underdog-only support. Not net demand.

large_purchase_value.description: Total qualifying grouped BUY dollars across both tokens; zero when no purchases qualify.

large_purchase_status.description: available, no_purchases, nonpositive_median, no_qualifying_purchases or no_cutoff_favorite; absence of purchases is not zero favorite support.

trend_status_24h.description: available, history_shorter_than_horizon, no_hourly_price_history, no_price_at_or_before_anchor, anchor_older_than_tolerance or no_cutoff_favorite; timing eligibility is checked before favorite availability.

trend_anchor_target_24h.description: Forecast cutoff minus 24 hours (nominally 48 hours before the event).

trend_anchor_observed_24h.description: Latest hourly observation at/before the 24-hour anchor within the collected window; retained even if older than tolerance; null without an eligible earlier observation.

trend_anchor_age_hours_24h.description: Target anchor minus observed anchor, in hours; retained even if stale; null without an eligible earlier observation.
trend_anchor_age_hours_24h.source: effective hourly price window + cutoff snapshot

trend_anchor_probability_24h.description: First-token probability at the earlier anchor, accepted only if at most six hours old; null for inadequate history.
trend_anchor_probability_24h.source: effective hourly price window + cutoff snapshot

trend_observed_hours_24h.description: Actual hours between the accepted earlier anchor and cutoff snapshot; may differ from 24 due to observation ages.
trend_observed_hours_24h.source: effective hourly price window + cutoff snapshot

favorite_change_pp_24h.description: 100*(cutoff probability - earlier anchor probability), sign-reversed if token 1 is the cutoff favorite. Positive means favorite gaining support; negative means losing. Null without adequate history or a favorite; no interpolation or future backfill.
favorite_change_pp_24h.source: effective hourly price window + cutoff snapshot

source_capture_id.description: Market ID plus SHA-256 of its effective result.json; identifies the frozen capture.

source_register_file.description: Project-relative current audit register; join by market_id.

captured_at_utc.description: Collection timestamp; later than forecast, not a predictor.

source_capture_id.description: Market ID plus SHA-256 of its effective result.json; identifies the frozen capture.

trade_row_id.description: Stable source-row identity; not a unique fill ID.

condition_id.description: Condition ID used for the market join.

token_id.description: Traded token ID, kept as text.

wallet_address.description: Lowercase wallet address; profile names are not identifiers.

transaction_hash.description: Lowercase transaction hash; may contain many distinct returned records.

side.description: Returned BUY or SELL, without an inferred maker/taker role.

outcome_label_raw.description: Original returned label, preserved including punctuation differences.

outcome_label.description: Canonical token-index label from saved market metadata.

exact_signature_id.description: SHA-256 of market ID and complete original row; candidate grouping, not fill identity.

trade_time_utc.description: UTC time of the returned trade record, with second precision.

outcome_index.description: 0 or 1; validated against the asset/token ID.

first_outcome_direction.description: +1 for BUY 0 or SELL 1; -1 for SELL 0 or BUY 1. Semantic direction, not inferred net demand.

duplicate_group_size.description: Number of identical full rows in this market capture.

duplicate_occurrence.description: One-based occurrence in original source order; defines the sensitivity view.

row_notional.description: Unrounded price times size in dollar-equivalent consideration.

outcome_label_changed.description: Canonical label differs from preserved original text.

duplicate_candidate.description: The exact signature has more than one source occurrence.

duplicate_excess.description: Occurrence beyond the first exact-signature row.

in_exact_signature_sensitivity.description: Keep this row in the separately named sensitivity view.

source_file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the compressed source file; also recorded in manifest.json.

source_row_index.description: Zero-based index in the original effective source array, before sorting.

source_capture_id.description: Market ID plus SHA-256 of its effective result.json; identifies the frozen capture.

price_row_id.description: Stable identity of the observed source price row.

token_id.description: First outcome token; no synthetic complement series.

observation_time_utc.description: UTC time of the actual returned hourly observation.

hours_before_cutoff.description: Elapsed hours from this observation to effective forecast cutoff.

elapsed_seconds_since_previous.description: Actual gap to preceding observed point; null for first point.

observed_change_pp.description: 100*(current probability - previous observed probability); null for first point.

gap_over_90_minutes.description: Actual observed interval exceeds 5400 seconds; null for first point.

gap_over_6_hours.description: Actual observed interval exceeds 21600 seconds; null for first point.

source_file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the compressed source file; also recorded in manifest.json.

source_row_index.description: Zero-based index in the original effective source array, before sorting.
